findings.reason: the third of the three sources the section names as dropped needs an explicit rule to suppress the readiness ref at validation, or a node implements the flag in the derivation and the gate hold silently survives.
findings.text: §31 says none of the three inherited sources (section `plan-section-depends-on` refs, plan `depends_on`, and the gates on its section) applies under the flag, but gate holds do not arrive through `derive_wait_refs`: `_validated_batch_waits` appends a `readiness:<project>:<slug>#<section>` ref whenever the section's own verdict carries a `gate` or `decision` blocker (`reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:1364-1383`), and it does so from the node's section regardless of any new flag; a flagged request whose section is gate-held would therefore still be stored `awaiting-upstream` on that ref, and no done-when arm covers a gate-held section

findings.reason: an arm that a broken sibling inheritance passes cannot show the defect was fixed; the arm must state that both requests wait together in one `advance_waiting_requests` pass so the cached derivation is what the assertion reads.
findings.text: the sibling arm, "A request with no `--after`, whose section sibling is `--after` request X, never waits on X", can pass on the unfixed code: at dispatch a request's waits never include a sibling's `run:` ref, and the only leak is the shared rederivation cache keyed on `(repo_root, node.plan, node.section)` without `node.after` (`reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:2054-2059`), which needs both requests to be candidates of one admission pass with the sibling derived first, so an assertion on the stored request after a second dispatch measures nothing and the stated negative control (ignoring the flag) exercises only the first arm

findings.reason: the four bullets are explicit and unambiguous, so a worker implements all four whatever the lead-in says; only the count word is stale.
findings.text: the done-when lead-in says the new test "shows three things" while the list now carries four bullets (the sibling arm was added without the count)
